performance_case.causal_mechanism: Separating optional cross-task Coach delivery from the sole normally due heartbeat prevents an unavailable conversation capability from stopping canonical evidence capture while exact receipts, pending-event durability and every scientific gate remain fail-closed.
performance_case.claim_boundary: Acceptance can prove only V10 repository bytes, frozen V9 predecessor integrity, exact queue attestation, zero-receipt caller semantics, pending-event and SLA-debt durability, focused offline tests and no-write scope. It cannot prove deployment, platform acceptance, cross-task tool availability, live heartbeat success, R1/R2 advancement, Coach receipt, prediction, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero because this contract cannot execute or promote a strategy. Any future drawdown benefit remains MISSING_PROOF until a separately preregistered candidate passes matched-capital forward evidence.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One bounded eight-file contract slice and later versioned cutover are cheaper than adding a second schedule, external messenger or user relay, while strict V9 risks losing one prospective evidence day whenever cross-task tools are absent.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted PnL is unchanged; preserving one lawful daily research heartbeat should reduce avoidable missed prospective evidence and shorten time to falsify or support bounded mechanisms.
